Header.description: I'm a Front-End and Mobile Developer focused on building fast, well-designed, and user-friendly digital products. I work mainly with React, Next.js, React Native, and Expo, while also stepping into backend work when the product needs solid APIs, integrations, and infrastructure.

acelera.name: Acelera Concursos
acelera.description:
- Work on the evolution of an education SaaS platform for exam preparation, connecting the mobile app, web dashboard, and backend into one integrated experience for students, teachers, and internal operations.
- Build the mobile app with Expo, React Native, and TypeScript, covering authentication, navigation, push notifications, deep links, live classes with Zoom, and Android/iOS release stability improvements.
- Also contribute to backend and infrastructure with NestJS, Supabase, BullMQ queues, Railway, and multi-tenant flows, handling migrations, permissions, deployments, async jobs, and critical product integrations.
acelera.skills: Expo, React Native, TypeScript, NestJS, Supabase, Railway, BullMQ, Zoom SDK, Git

slabware.name: Slabware
slabware.description:
- Developed and scaled React Native / Expo apps, refactoring legacy code and shipping new features with a focus on performance and UX.
- Led state management migration from Redux to Zustand, adopting a leaner, more modern approach that reduced boilerplate and improved maintainability.
- Maintained high coding standards through peer code reviews and consistent TypeScript usage.
slabware.skills: Expo, React Native, Zustand, Typescript, Git

beebee.name: BeeBee
beebee.description:
- Built a real-time operations dashboard in React.js and TanStack Table for internal teams to monitor deliveries end to end, including request status, driver acceptance, SLA timing, and operational issues.
- Implemented live delivery-status updates via Websockets with Pusher, allowing employees to track changes instantly without manual refresh.
- Worked on a delivery flow where clients requested deliveries through the app and drivers accepted jobs on mobile, ensuring the dashboard accurately reflected each stage of the operation in real time.
beebee.skills: React, TanStack Table, Websockets, Pusher, Typescript, Git

gmill.name: Grupo GMill
gmill.description:
- Led the full migration of a legacy Angular application to a modern React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS stack, improving performance and developer experience.
- Built and refined responsive React + TypeScript interfaces during the migration, improving usability and maintainability across internal workflows.
- Optimized applications for speed, maintainability, and responsive design across devices.

atw.name: ATW Delivery Brands
atw.description:
- Developed REST APIs with Node.js and Express; integrated databases with Prisma ORM.
- Prototyped a real-time chat feature using Socket.io — directly relevant to Websocket-based communication.
- Wrote automated tests with Jest, reinforcing a culture of quality and testing best practices.
atw.skills: Node.js, Express, Prisma, Socket.io, Jest, Git

uvv.name: UVV
uvv.description: - Built a .NET API for a virtual reality research project; developed UI prototypes in Unity with C#.

uvv-volunteer.name: UVV
uvv-volunteer.description: I joined a virtual reality project where I learned Unity with C#. I focused on UI prototyping and gained hands-on experience in game development and UX design.
